source_provenance.question: Evaluate the following expressions to the nearest hundredth or as an exact ratio.
source_provenance.previous_model_response:
The point on the unit circle is \((x,y)=(0.2,0.98)\). Thus,

\[
\sin\theta=y=0.98,\qquad
\cos\theta=x=0.20,
\]

and

\[
\tan\theta=\frac{y}{x}
=\frac{0.98}{0.20}
=\frac{49}{10}=4.90.
\]

The reciprocal functions are

\[
\csc\theta=\frac{50}{49}\approx1.02,\quad
\sec\theta=5,\quad
\cot\theta=\frac{10}{49}\approx0.20.
\]

Final values: \(\sin\theta=0.98,\ \cos\theta=0.20,\ \tan\theta=4.90\).
